timeline.text: Welcome to this session. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I miss someone right now.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps drifting back to them.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: This distance feels harder than I expected.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I notice how much I wish they were here.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels this absence.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Part of me wants to reach out right now.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can admit how much this ache matters to me.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: This longing is real, even if I can’t explain it fully.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: Missing them doesn’t mean something is wrong with me.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let myself miss them without rushing past it.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: This ache is a sign of how much they mattered.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I don’t have to fix this feeling to get through today.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can hold this longing gently instead of fighting it.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften even while this ache is here.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel this without it meaning I’m not okay.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can carry this feeling and still move through my day.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to miss them and still be at peace.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This feeling can exist alongside everything else that’s good in my life.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I’m capable of holding this longing with care.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I trust that this feeling will ease in its own time.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to cherish what they mean to me.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can find comfort in the memory of them.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can rest, even with this ache present.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I’m learning to carry this without it weighing everything down.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I can let love and longing exist together.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to feel connected to them, even from here.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to get through today, missing them and all.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
